name: Tasklet
notes: Business agent platform: delegate email handling, CRM enrichment, tool syncing and reports to agents that run 24x7 over thousands of SaaS tools, MCP servers and a browser. Web and Mac app with Slack and email hooks, not a texting assistant, so on the board as a stretch product. Requested via the form (issue #165).

access.price: 7-day trial with 5,000 credits; Starter $25/mo, Pro $100/mo, Custom from $250/mo; billed per organization
